source_search_findings: The Arabic and English CIS, Applied Medical Sciences-Rabigh, and Communication and Media faculty pages were retrieved. Their visible and embedded navigation exposed regulations but no curriculum PDF, course-description table, handbook, or elective-option document for the target blockers.
The official KAU search page for JCOM 211 returned HTTP 200, but JCOM 211 occurred only in the query state and no course result was published.
Fresh bilingual Computer Science and Information Technology plans supplied authoritative identities and curriculum context for CS 121, CS 351, IT 203, and IT 211.
A fresh bilingual Rabigh Nursing plan supplied authoritative shared-faculty identities for BIO 112 and CHEM 112 and an independent ARAB 201 comparison.
A fresh bilingual Visual and Audio Production plan supplied a fourth official media-program comparison, but no missing media prerequisite identity or elective-option table.

The resolvable legacy official host fcit.kau.edu.sa timed out over both HTTP and HTTPS; no content was captured or used. Other tested faculty-host candidates did not resolve. No unofficial content was used as academic evidence.

media_cross_program_reconciliation.unresolved_reason: The codes appear only as requisite references in the scoped plans and have no authoritative course row in any of the four compared media curricula.
media_cross_program_reconciliation.elective_result: Each scoped media plan publishes four scheduled 3-credit elective/free placeholders, but no plan publishes option codes, bilingual option names, group membership, selection count, or selection-credit rules. media_cross_program_reconciliation.curriculum_version_result: The retrieved pages publish no explicit curriculum version or effective date, so matching rows were accepted only where all available academic fields agree; missing-code identities were not transferred between programs.
